verdict.detail: Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Released on a pink Island label with white ''i'' logo. Rough-textured label.
First cat.nr. on cover, second on label.

℗ 1970

Recorded in February, March and April 1970 at Island Studios, London

Printed and made by the E.J. Day Group, London and Bedford

Publishing info:
A1, A2, B1 to B3 - Andover Music
A3, B4 - RSO Publishing

Runouts are stamped.
